summary: If p is short, every collision has e ≥ 1 and the factor m is in loss; otherwise every collision has e > 𝔯 (else p would be served), and m ≤ p^𝔯.

steps.claim: loss ≥ 2·f·(a/p)·μ (as (log b)² ≥ 2). If p is short (μ = m): collisions have e ≥ 1, so collisionSum ≤ 2fa/p (`collisionSum_le` with o = 1) and m·collisionSum ≤ loss.

If p is not short: every collision (τ, e) has e ≥ 𝔯 + 1 — a collision forces p ≠ d, e odd and o₀ ∣ e (`IsCollision.ne_and_odd_and_dvd`), so o₀ is odd and χ_K(p) = −1; were o₀ ≤ 𝔯 then p would be served — hence collisionSum ≤ 2fa/p^{𝔯+1}, and m ≤ p^𝔯 (`le_pow_clog`).
steps.lean:
grw [collisionSum_le (o := D.ceilLogM p + 1) (by grind [IsServed, IsCollision.ne_and_odd_and_dvd,
    IsCollision, chiK_cases, Odd.of_dvd_nat,
    → le_of_dvd]), le_pow_clog q.1.one_lt D.m, ← ceilLogM]
